route: WETH -> PEPE in Uniswap V2; PEPE -> WETH in Uniswap V3
interpretation: Same-sender front/target/back sandwich structure. Back-leg positive cashflow must be combined with front-leg cost. A fixed-input, fixed-route two-pool quote model reproduces actual output exactly and measures removal of one target trade. The actual transaction could revert or not be submitted without the target; this is not full execution replay or event-wide MEV.
counterfactual_scope: Remove only the immediately preceding target trade; hold front leg, route, WETH input, earlier trades, gas and direct payment fixed. Reconstruct second-pool price/liquidity and WETH balance after the front leg. Not a full-block reexecution, event-wide attribution, or behavioral equilibrium model.
